shortDescription: Manage IRF port creation and removal for Comware v7 devices

options.name: activate
options.description: activate the IRF after the configuration is initially performed

options.name: filename
options.description: Where to save the current configuration. Default is startup.cfg.

options.name: irf_p1
options.description: Physical Interface or List of Physical Interfaces that will be bound to IRF port 1. Any physical interfaces not in the list will be removed from the IRF port. An empty list removes all interfaces.

options.name: irf_p2
options.description: Physical Interface or List of Physical Interfaces that will be bound to IRF port 2. Any physical interfaces not in the list will be removed from the IRF port. An empty list removes all interfaces.

options.name: member_id
options.description: IRF member id for switch (must be unique). IRF member ids can be configured with the comware_irf_members module.

options.name: removal_override
options.description: When set to true, allows the removal of physical ports from IRF port(s). Removing physical ports may have adverse effects and be disallowed by the switch. Disconnecting all IRF ports could lead to a split-brain scenario.
